item.title: Sophia J. Skiba
item.description: Sophia J. Skiba, 87, of Oil City, passed away December 3, 2025, at Oil City Healthcare. Born June 15, 1938, in Oil City, she was the daughter of the late John and Josephine Lisowksi Smutek. Sophie attended Assumption B.V.M. School and was a graduate of Oil City High School. She worked in the clerical department at the Oil City Hospital. ... Read More The post Sophia J. Skiba appeared first on exploreVenango.
